brand_identity.name: EduLink+
brand_identity.tone: Academic yet Modern, Trusted, Growth-Oriented, Human
brand_identity.aesthetic: Light & Clean (Ivy League meets Modern SaaS)

headings.usage: Main headings (H1-H3), Hero sections, Feature titles

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI elements, Navigation, Data display

accent.description: Electric Mint - Growth & Energy (The E1 Twist)

marketing.name: The Tetris Grid
marketing.rules: Use asymmetry. Hero spans 8 cols, supporting content spans 4. Never fill 100% perfectly.

dashboard.name: The Control Room
dashboard.rules: Dense, data-heavy. Widgets stretch to fill height.

buttons.marketing: rounded-full px-8 py-6 text-lg font-medium transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1

cards.style: bg-white border border-border/40 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

inputs.style: bg-transparent border-b-2 border-border focus:border-primary rounded-none px-0 transition-colors
inputs.note: Use 'Underline' style for marketing forms, standard boxed inputs for dashboard.

universal_guidelines: DO NOT use gradients for text or backgrounds. Stick to solid, high-quality colors.
Use 'Playfair Display' for all H1-H3 headings. Use 'Manrope' for body.
Ensure all interactive elements have `data-testid` attributes.
Light Mode ONLY. Do not implement dark mode toggles.
Use 2x more whitespace than you think is necessary.
Images must be high-quality and relevant. No generic clip art.
For the dashboard, prioritize data density but keep it breathable with padding.
Marketing pages should feel like an editorial magazine, not a bootstrap template.
instructions_to_main_agent: You are building the frontend for EduLink+. Follow these guidelines strictly. Use the provided image URLs. Implement the 'Tetris Grid' for the landing page and 'Control Room' grid for the dashboard. Use Shadcn UI components but customize them to match the 'Old Money Tech' aesthetic (Serif headings, sharp borders or specific radii). Ensure the 'Electric Mint' accent is used sparingly for high-impact CTAs only.
